name: vLLM-DCU on Hygon DCU
description: AccelMark runner for Hygon DCU accelerators via the ROCm-compatible DTK stack. DCU enumerated as ROCm/HIP; no device flag. BF16/FP16/FP32; FP8 unsupported. GPTQ/INT8; RCCL tensor parallelism.
notes: gfx906 (Vega/MI50-class) falls back to the MATH SDPA path (no flash-attn/aotriton kernel); the runner patches _sdpa_attention and raises VLLM_ENGINE_ITERATION_TIMEOUT_S=600 so online/interactive finish despite slow decode (vLLM #6254). suite_F validated on Z200SM_80 (16 GB). suite_A (Llama-3-8B BF16 ~15 GB) does not fit 16 GB - needs >=32 GB.
